question: g2_add_voucher
answer:
Done. `addToCart` in [cartActions.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/okf/work/g2_add_voucher/okf/codex/3/src/redux/actions/cartActions.js) now takes an optional `promoCode` as its last parameter, and when truthy adds `voucher: promoCode` to the request body — so it goes out with both the POST (add) and PUT (update) cart requests. When no code is given, the `voucher` field is simply never set, so the payload is unchanged.

The field name comes from the backend: the add/update-cart endpoints (`POST /api/v1/cart`, `PUT /api/v1/cart/{code}`) take a `BasketLineInput` body, whose discount-code field is `voucher` (the cart-level `promoCode` belongs to the cart response model, not the item request).

Files used:
- `src/redux/actions/cartActions.js` — the only file changed
- `okf/index.md` and the backend reference docs `okf/references/backend/routes.md`, `okf/references/backend/modules/com.salesmanager.shop.store.api.v1.shoppingCart.md`, and `.../com.salesmanager.shop.model.shoppingcart.md` — to identify `BasketLineInput.voucher` as the discount-code field

Syntax checked with Node; diff is the minimal 4-line addition plus the signature change.

/bin/bash -lc "cd ~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/okf/work/g2_add_voucher/okf/codex/3 && git show HEAD:src/redux/actions/cartActions.js > /tmp/orig_cart.js && python3 - <<'EOF'

new_sig = \"export const addToCart = (item, addToast, cartId, quantityCount, defaultStore, userData, selectedProductOptions, promoCode) => {\"

new_param = old_param + nl + \"      if (promoCode) {\" + nl + \"        param.voucher = promoCode;\" + nl + \"      }\"
assert orig.count(old_sig) == 1 and orig.count(old_param) == 1
out = orig.replace(old_sig, new_sig).replace(old_param, new_param)
open(p, 'wb').write(out.encode('utf-8'))
EOF
